sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the broad sh:targetClass nltl:shipComponent target, which incorrectly requires this calculation on every ship component, with an evidence-triggered target such as sh:targetSubjectsOf nltl:requiredShearArea. Encode f13 directly as the prescribed constant 1.1 rather than requiring a separate RDF value. The supplied verified record does not establish the Table 4-8 threshold and alpha values, so remove the 0.1/1.5/1.0 selection checks unless those table rows are separately verified; retain alpha as the formula operand. The squared formula coefficient 300 is otherwise consistent with Q in kN, yield strength in MPa, and area in cm².
